scene: A young medieval woman artist leisurely strolls beside the Seine in medieval Paris, enjoying its stone bridges, riverside stalls and the recognisable Gothic twin towers of Notre-Dame in the distance. She pauses happily at an outdoor tavern table with a small cup, relaxed and unhurried. Rich Gothic Parisian streetscape; no Eiffel Tower, modern cafes, written menus, signs or writing. Convey enjoying Paris rather than generic hurried travel.

One coherent castle training-yard scene contrasts an energetic woman captain, standing upright and directing her guards with a firm vigorous gesture, with an exhausted apprentice seated nearby receiving a plain earthenware cup of nourishing drink and a piece of bread from the cook. Her posture embodies energy in a person; the offered refreshments supply energy. No modern energy-drink container, lettering, diagrams or split-panel composition.

A medieval pastry cook watches a beautifully golden tart inside an open stone oven, holding a wooden peel poised to remove it at exactly the right moment. A small bowl of glossy amber glaze and a spoon rest nearby; the cook's attentive satisfied face and poised hands convey nearly ready and optimal timing. Warm kitchen firelight, delicate steam, convincing baked pastry, no clock face, numbers or writing.

Inside a Gothic hall, a teacher gently shows a nervous young apprentice a clearly flat woven tapestry depicting a red dragon. The tapestry is recognisably an artistic representation, while the youth's tense shoulders and fearful glance convey the dragon as a metaphor for his inner fear. A single coherent scene with only one clearly woven dragon image, no real attacking dragon, inset diagram, letters, symbols or books with writing. This is a nonverbal evocation of representation versus symbolic meaning, not a grammar diagram.

A poised medieval woman diplomat stands quietly between two offended nobles at a Gothic banquet table. Instead of accusatory pointing, she uses a small open-handed conciliatory gesture and a discreet warm expression; the nobles slowly relax their clenched hands and meet each other's gaze. Emphasise understated tact and delicate communication through restrained expressions, no shouting, written message or speech bubbles.

In a medieval castle schoolroom, a patient woman librarian gently lowers and puts aside an old teacher's wooden teaching rod, protecting the children from punitive instruction. She offers them an open book with completely blank pages and a welcoming smile; the old teacher stands back, surprised. Focus on compassionate learning in place of harsh punishment, no striking, injuries, blood, threats, fear-based spectacle or visible letters. Warm golden light in a Gothic library.

A wealthy medieval merchant arrives at a Gothic castle in an ornate gilded horse-drawn carriage, accompanied by servants carrying silk-filled chests and luxurious rugs. He gestures toward an extravagant banquet being prepared, while a concerned treasurer studies his dwindling open coin purse without any written ledger. Convey a costly sustained luxurious lifestyle, no railway, modern objects, signs or written numbers.

In a lively medieval castle kitchen, a baker sings a familiar song while kneading dough; apprentices, kitchen workers and two passing guards recognise the repeated refrain and join together in a joyful coordinated chorus, open mouths and shared anticipation visible. One complete simultaneous scene, no repeated figures or inset panels. Convey a shared recognisable refrain through group response, without musical-note glyphs, score, captions or writing.

A confused young squire stands at a junction of unfamiliar Gothic castle corridors adjoining a medieval cartwright's workshop. In the safe damp workshop corner, an unharmed octopus that has escaped a nearby broad water basin sprawls awkwardly among wooden cart wheels and horseshoes; both squire and animal seem out of place. Make the octopus anatomically recognisable, not monstrous. No cars, modern garage, labels, maps, speech bubbles or diagrams. Gentle visual analogy for complete disorientation.

A medieval woman blacksmith presents a magnificent star-metal sword across an anvil to a traveller who recoils in astonishment at its enormous price. He opens an almost empty purse while a large heap of coins on the counter and his waiting saddled horse outside suggest the great sacrifice required to afford it. Emphasise extraordinary expense and his shocked expression, no egg, written prices, coin inscriptions, sales tags or modern weaponry.
